description:
Found 2026-09-10 by the ERRORR MF=32 tier-2 oracle on TENDL-2023 Ar-37 (MAT 1828, LRU=1/LRF=2 MLBW, bound levels at -3236/-681/-2100 eV). Crate reconr (0 K, tol 0.001) vs NJOY2016 ac5adf5 RECONR tape21 (scratchpad/w6-njoy/ar37-oracle/tape21, deck reference-data/errorr/ar37-tendl2023-L1last-*.njoy-input):
MT=2  E=1e-5..1e0 eV: crate 1.2062 b vs njoy 1.1344 b (+6.33%, flat); E=100 eV +6.23%; E=1 keV -8.23%; E=4 keV -5.53%; E=4268 eV -2.18%; on the 1540/2630 eV peaks -1.8e-4/-4.6e-4; above the RRR identical.
MT=102 everywhere within 1.4e-5 (1e-7 typical).
Cause (read, not yet fixed): src/reconr/slbw.rs eval_slbw_lstate is used for LRF=1 AND LRF=2 — doc says 'true MLBW adds interference between levels in the elastic channel, which is negligible for widely-spaced resonances'. NJOY's csmlbw (reconr.f90) instead accumulates per-J sigj(j,1)/sigj(j,2) over all levels of an l-state and forms sigp(2)=pifac*sum_j gj*((cos2p-sigj1)^2+(sin2p+sigj2)^2) + 2*diff*cos2p (diff=2l+1-sum gj). With Ar-37's large bound-level neutron widths (52 eV at -3236 eV) the level-level and level-potential interference is several percent of the off-resonance elastic. Capture is unaffected because the capture formula is identical in SLBW/MLBW.
The same formula is now ported and oracle-validated in src/errorr/resprx/mlbw.rs (ggmlbw, 'based on csmlbw'): the ERRORR sensitivities built on it match NJOY to 5e-7. Fix = add eval_mlbw_lstate to reconr/slbw.rs (dispatch on lrf) and validate against tape21 at 0 K (elastic should drop to the ~2e-4 peak-level agreement) and tape22 at 293.6 K; then tests/errorr_mf32_ar37_golden.rs tier 2 sigma_g(MT=2, ig=1) should move from +6% toward the op-tubm-only residual. Check tests/reconr_ar37.rs for assertions that pin the SLBW numbers.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
FIXED 2026-09-10 (worktree agent-w6). reconr::slbw::eval_mlbw_lstate ports csmlbw's per-J elastic assembly (sigj(J,1)/sigj(J,2) over all levels of the l-state + 2(2l+1-sum gJ)(1-cos2phi)); reconr::add_slbw_range dispatches LRF=1 -> csslbw, LRF=2 -> csmlbw (reconr.f90:2610-2616). Competitive width (LRX!=0, QX) still not carried by LState — same pre-existing gap as SLBW, documented in the fn doc.
Oracle: NJOY2016 ac5adf5 RECONR tape21 for TENDL-2023 Ar-37 (err 0.001, 0 K), committed as reference-data/reconr/ar37-tendl2023-0K.pendf + deck. Measured (tests/reconr_ar37_mlbw_njoy_golden.rs): MT=2 within 4.1e-7 below 100 eV (was +6.33e-2), worst 4.5e-4 at 1400 eV (wing); MT=102 unchanged (5.6e-5 at 1e-2 eV, 3.0e-4 at 1400 eV — lin-lin interpolation between differently thinned grids); MT=1 reported only: 1.45% at 4 keV, 0.34% at 4268 eV where MT=2/102 agree (MF=3 total background near the RRR/URR edge — not chased, candidate follow-up). 293.6 K PENDF vs NJOY tape22: MT=2 within 1.3e-4 at 1e-4..1e5 eV. ERRORR MF=32 tier 2 sigma_g worst 6.0e-2 -> 3.7e-3. Full suite 784/0/8 across 49 binaries. Commit pushed to develop.

title: RECONR: LRF=2 (MLBW) evaluations reconstructed with the SLBW elastic formula — Ar-37 elastic +6.3% at low E, -8.2% at 1 keV vs NJOY2016 tape21 (capture matches to 1e-7)
